hero.lead: Build the strategies that shape economies with CFA-aligned learning, master forecasting, valuation & investing in a data-driven financial landscape.

panes.label: Overview
panes.text: The B.Sc. in Finance at ATLAS ISME is designed for ambitious minds who want to master the art and science of financial decision-making in a global economy. Aligned with the globally recognised CFA Program, this degree blends the rigour of financial theory with the dynamism of real-world markets to prepare you for a future in investment, banking, fintech and beyond. Through hands-on simulations, live market labs, investment challenges and mentorship from finance professionals, you’ll learn how money moves, how businesses grow and how to drive decisions that shape economies. With exposure to industry-relevant concepts in investment analysis, valuation, portfolio management and financial markets, you’ll build the knowledge and skills sought by leading employers across the finance industry.

Introduces statistical and mathematical tools used in financial analysis. Emphasizes data-driven decision-making, forecasting, and analytical reasoning.

Focuses on firm-level decision-making using microeconomic principles. Explores market structures, pricing, and competitive strategy.
Builds foundational spreadsheet skills for organizing, analyzing, and presenting data. Students learn essential functions and workflows used in business analytics.
Develops core communication skills for professional environments. Emphasizes clarity, structure, and effectiveness in written and verbal interactions.
Allows students to explore interest-based subjects aligned with emerging fields and career pathways. Encourages applied, skill-focused learning.
